name: Viviana
description: A poor but beautiful woman comes to the city looking for her husband ... who is married to another woman, the evil Gloria. While she falls in love to a handsome and good hearted doctor, she decides to work at nights to earn money at a "Model School" which is, in reality, a high profile brothel...

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Viviana walks on the beach and suddenly meets the handsome Jorge Armando.
